title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫~UHPC bridge-deck closure joints
focus: 以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水~Short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight
summary: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。~Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.

units.anchor: 接縫介面彎曲應力~Joint-interface flexural stress
units.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑~Load path through precast deck joints
units.mechanism: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。超高性能混凝土的強度與握裹力極高，使接縫可窄到約 150 mm，鋼筋只需短距離非接觸搭接。但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。~Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint. UHPC's very high strength and bond allow joints only about 150 mm wide with short non-contact lap splices. Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete.
units.model: 接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。數值除 UHPC 強度外為教學假設。~With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Values other than the UHPC strength are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。~Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks.
units.failure: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。~Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.
units.misconception: UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。~UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack.
units.practice: 接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。~Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.

units.anchor: 收縮約束應力~Restrained shrinkage stress
units.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束~Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint
units.mechanism: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。~UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools. If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path.
units.model: 約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。E = 48 GPa、長期收縮 ε = 555×10⁻⁶、約束度 R = 0.3、潛變鬆弛係數 k = 0.5：σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa，低於 UHPC 開裂強度約 8.5 MPa，但可能超過未粗糙化介面的黏結強度。數值除材料性質外為教學假設。~Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k. With E = 48 GPa, long-term shrinkage ε = 555×10⁻⁶, restraint R = 0.3 and creep relaxation factor k = 0.5: σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa, below UHPC's cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but possibly above the bond strength of an unroughened interface. Values other than material properties are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。~Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter.
units.failure: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。~Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years.
units.misconception: UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。~UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
units.practice: 規格書要列出 UHPC 收縮上限、澆置時的氣溫與預鑄板表面溫度範圍、初期養護方式（封閉保濕至初凝），並禁止以熱風直吹新澆表面；接縫監測計畫在設計時就納入。~The specification lists the UHPC shrinkage limit, air and panel-surface temperature ranges for casting and early curing (sealed and moist until initial set), and forbids forced hot air on fresh surfaces; joint monitoring is planned at design.

units.anchor: 非接觸搭接長度 ℓ_s~Non-contact lap length ℓ_s
units.title: 鋼筋搭接長度與接縫寬度~Lap-splice length and joint width
units.mechanism: 接縫中的鋼筋不需要互相接觸，而是由兩側伸出的鋼筋交錯排列，拉力經由周圍 UHPC 的握裹與纖維橋接傳到另一側鋼筋。FHWA 2014 年的技術說明建議：在 2% 鋼纖維、抗壓強度至少 14 ksi、保護層至少 3 倍筋徑、鋼筋不大於 8 號且降伏強度不超過 75 ksi 時，伸展長度 ℓ_d 取 8 倍筋徑，搭接長度 ℓ_s 至少 0.75ℓ_d；鋼筋強度在 75 至 100 ksi 時取 10 倍，保護層只有 2 至 3 倍筋徑時再加 2 倍筋徑，且相鄰搭接筋的淨距不得超過 ℓ_s。接縫寬度則要在搭接長度外保留製造與安裝允差。~Bars in the joint need not touch; bars projecting from each side interleave, and tension passes through bond in the surrounding UHPC and fibre bridging to the bars opposite. FHWA's 2014 TechNote recommends that, with 2% steel fibre, compressive strength of at least 14 ksi, cover of at least three bar diameters, bars no larger than No. 8 and yield strength up to 75 ksi, the development length ℓ_d be 8 bar diameters and the lap ℓ_s at least 0.75ℓ_d; bars of 75 to 100 ksi take 10 diameters, cover of only 2 to 3 diameters adds 2 diameters, and clear spacing to the nearest spliced bar may not exceed ℓ_s. Joint width must then add fabrication and erection tolerance to the lap length.
units.model: 16 mm 鋼筋、f_y ≤ 75 ksi、保護層 ≥ 3d_b：ℓ_d = 8×16 = 128 mm，ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm。若改用 100 ksi 級鋼筋且保護層僅 2.5d_b：ℓ_d = (10 + 2)×16 = 192 mm，ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm，152 mm 接縫幾乎沒有允差，宜加寬到約 203 mm。數值為教學假設。~For 16 mm bars with f_y ≤ 75 ksi and cover ≥ 3d_b: ℓ_d = 8×16 = 128 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm. With 100 ksi bars and only 2.5d_b cover: ℓ_d = (10 + 2)×16 = 192 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm, leaving a 152 mm joint almost no tolerance, so widen it to about 203 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預鑄廠檢查伸出鋼筋的長度、間距、保護層與位置，製作接縫配筋的實尺寸樣板，在吊裝前試套確認兩側鋼筋交錯不衝突；吊裝後量測實際搭接長度與淨距，記錄在每一道接縫的查驗表中。~At the precast plant check projecting bar length, spacing, cover and position, make a full-size template of the joint reinforcement and trial-fit it before erection to confirm the interleaving bars do not clash; after erection measure actual lap length and clear spacing, recording them on each joint's inspection sheet.
units.failure: 預鑄板伸出筋位置偏差，吊裝時兩側鋼筋互相頂住，現場把鋼筋彎折或切短以便就位，實際搭接長度低於要求；或接縫寬度剛好等於搭接長度，任何吊裝偏差都讓搭接不足。~Projecting bars out of position clash during erection, and site crews bend or cut them to make the panels fit, leaving laps below the requirement; or a joint exactly as wide as the lap length means any erection deviation produces an inadequate lap.
units.misconception: UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。~UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will.
units.practice: 伸出筋的位置允差、接縫寬度與最小搭接長度要寫在預鑄板製造圖上，鋼筋切割或彎折一律須經設計者書面同意；紐約州 CR47 案例即把接縫做成 8 吋寬，比 6 吋搭接多留 2 吋現場允差。~Projecting-bar tolerances, joint width and minimum lap length go on the panel shop drawings, and any cutting or bending of bars needs the designer's written approval; New York's CR47 project made its joint 8 inches wide, leaving 2 inches of field tolerance beyond a 6 inch lap.

units.title: UHPC 組成與材料性質~UHPC constituents and material properties
units.mechanism: UHPC 以級配最佳化的細顆粒（水泥、矽灰、細砂與填料）、低於 0.25 的水膠比、高效減水劑與大量短鋼纖維組成，不含粗骨材。緻密的基材使抗壓強度超過 150 MPa、氯離子滲透極低；鋼纖維在開裂後跨越裂縫持續傳遞拉力，使材料具有超過 5 MPa 的持續開裂後拉力強度，這也是短搭接成立的關鍵。FHWA 的現澆 UHPC 試驗數據顯示 28 天抗壓強度平均約 165 MPa、直接拉伸開裂強度約 8.5 MPa、彈性模數約 48 GPa。~UHPC combines optimally graded fine particles (cement, silica fume, fine sand and fillers), a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25, high-range water reducer and a large dose of short steel fibres, with no coarse aggregate. The dense matrix gives compressive strength above 150 MPa and very low chloride penetrability; the fibres keep carrying tension across cracks after cracking, giving a sustained post-cracking tensile strength above 5 MPa, which is what makes short laps work. FHWA data for field-cast UHPC show an average 28-day compressive strength of about 165 MPa, direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa and an elastic modulus of about 48 GPa.
units.model: 纖維體積率 2%，單根纖維直徑 0.2 mm、長 13 mm，體積 π/4×0.0002²×0.013 ≈ 4.08×10⁻¹⁰ m³；每 m³ 約 0.02/4.08×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 4.9×10⁷ 根，鋼纖維重 0.02×7,850 ≈ 157 kg。以 E = 1,550√f′_c（ksi）估算，f′_c = 24 ksi 時 E ≈ 7,600 ksi（約 52 GPa）。~At 2% by volume, a fibre 0.2 mm in diameter and 13 mm long has a volume of π/4×0.0002²×0.013 ≈ 4.08×10⁻¹⁰ m³, so 1 m³ holds about 0.02/4.08×10⁻¹⁰ ≈ 4.9×10⁷ fibres weighing 0.02×7,850 ≈ 157 kg. Estimating E = 1,550√f′_c (ksi), f′_c = 24 ksi gives E ≈ 7,600 ksi (about 52 GPa).
units.verify: 材料送審時審查配比、纖維規格（直徑、長度、抗拉強度至少 2,000 MPa）、抗壓、開裂與開裂後拉力、氯離子滲透、凍融與收縮試驗報告；現場預拌包裝與纖維批號須與送審一致，並保留出廠證明。~At submittal review the mix, fibre specification (diameter, length and tensile strength of at least 2,000 MPa), and reports on compressive, cracking and post-cracking tensile strength, chloride penetrability, freeze–thaw and shrinkage; site pre-blended bags and fibre batches must match the submittal, with mill certificates kept.
units.failure: 現場以一般混凝土的拌合方式與時間處理 UHPC，纖維結團、分布不均，局部缺纖維區在開裂後失去拉力傳遞；或以較低纖維量的替代產品施作，搭接長度原本依 2% 纖維推導的前提就不成立。~Mixing UHPC with ordinary concrete equipment and times causes fibre balling and uneven distribution, so fibre-starved zones lose tensile transfer after cracking; substituting a product with less fibre invalidates the lap lengths derived for 2% fibre.
units.misconception: UHPC 只是強度比較高的混凝土，配比與纖維可以由現場自行調整。~UHPC is just stronger concrete, so mix and fibre content can be adjusted on site.
units.practice: 採用的 UHPC 產品要有完整的材料試驗與工程使用紀錄，替代產品須重新提出全部試驗資料並經設計者核可；拌合機型式、拌合時間與纖維投入順序依供應商程序並寫入施工計畫。~The chosen UHPC product must have full material test data and a field record; any substitute needs a complete new test submittal and designer approval, and mixer type, mixing time and fibre addition sequence follow the supplier's procedure in the method statement.

units.anchor: 介面粗糙化與 SSD~Interface roughening and SSD
units.title: 預鑄面處理與介面剪力~Precast surface preparation and interface shear
units.mechanism: UHPC 與預鑄混凝土之間的黏結決定接縫能否不開裂、不滲水。FHWA 的研究顯示，外露骨材面黏結最好，噴砂面次之，原模板面最差；建議預鑄介面粗糙化到約 6.4 mm 的凹凸幅度，最常用的方法是在預鑄時於模板塗緩凝劑、脫模後沖洗露出骨材。澆置前預鑄面要預濕到飽和面乾（SSD），避免乾燥的舊混凝土吸走 UHPC 介面的水分，但表面不得有積水。~Bond between UHPC and precast concrete decides whether the joint stays uncracked and watertight. FHWA research shows exposed-aggregate surfaces bond best, sandblasted surfaces next and as-cast form faces worst, and recommends roughening precast interfaces to an amplitude of about 6.4 mm, most often by applying retarder to the form at casting and washing the surface after stripping to expose aggregate. Before placement the precast face is prewetted to saturated surface-dry (SSD) so dry old concrete does not draw water from the UHPC at the interface, but no standing water may remain.
units.model: 以剪力摩擦概念 V = c·A_cv + μ·A_vf·f_y 估算每米接縫介面剪力能力：板厚 0.2 m、16 mm 筋@150 mm（A_vf ≈ 1,340 mm²/m、f_y = 420 MPa）。粗糙化 6 mm 取 c = 1.66 MPa、μ = 1.0，V ≈ 332 + 563 ≈ 895 kN/m；未粗糙化取 c = 0.52 MPa、μ = 0.6，V ≈ 104 + 338 ≈ 442 kN/m。數值為教學假設。~Estimate interface shear capacity per metre of joint with shear friction V = c·A_cv + μ·A_vf·f_y: deck 0.2 m thick with 16 mm bars at 150 mm (A_vf ≈ 1,340 mm²/m, f_y = 420 MPa). Roughened to 6 mm, c = 1.66 MPa and μ = 1.0 give V ≈ 332 + 563 ≈ 895 kN/m; unroughened, c = 0.52 MPa and μ = 0.6 give V ≈ 104 + 338 ≈ 442 kN/m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預鑄廠以量規或砂填法量測介面粗糙幅度，拍照記錄每塊板的介面；吊裝後、澆置前清除灰塵油污，以噴水預濕並在澆置前確認達到 SSD 且無積水，由監造簽認後才可澆置。~At the plant measure interface roughness amplitude by gauge or sand-patch method and photograph every panel's interface; after erection and before casting remove dust and oil, prewet by spraying and confirm SSD with no standing water just before placement, with the inspector signing off before casting.
units.failure: 預鑄廠漏做緩凝劑處理，介面只是光滑的模板面，或澆置前介面乾燥吸水，UHPC 與舊混凝土之間黏結薄弱；通車後介面在收縮與車輛荷重下脫開，形成沿接縫兩側的兩條滲水裂縫。~If the plant skips the retarder treatment, leaving a smooth form face, or the interface is dry and absorbent at casting, bond between UHPC and old concrete is weak; after opening the interface separates under shrinkage and traffic, forming two leakage cracks along both sides of the joint.
units.misconception: UHPC 黏結力很強，預鑄介面平滑也沒關係。~UHPC bonds so strongly that a smooth precast interface does not matter.
units.practice: 把介面處理寫進預鑄板製造規範並列為出廠檢查項目，現場再設「介面清潔與 SSD 確認」停留點；不合格的介面以噴砂或水刀補做粗糙化後重新檢查。~Write interface treatment into the precast fabrication specification as a factory inspection item, and add a site hold point for interface cleaning and SSD confirmation; nonconforming interfaces are roughened by abrasive blasting or water jetting and reinspected.

units.anchor: 模板密封與溢流頭~Form sealing and overfill head
units.title: 模板、澆置、溢流與養護~Formwork, placement, overfill and curing
units.mechanism: UHPC 流動性極高、顆粒極細，任何一般混凝土可接受的模板縫隙都可能漏漿，造成接縫內部空洞與表面下陷；它也會在模板上產生接近液體的側壓。FHWA 建議模板要比一般混凝土更密實、讓空氣有排出路徑，並在高處設置「煙囪」提供額外液壓頭，補償澆置後的沉降；有些承包商以注水測試模板是否漏水。可見的水平表面常刻意溢流，硬化後研磨到與兩側齊平，但研磨太早會撕裂 UHPC、太晚則磨耗設備。~UHPC is highly fluid with very fine particles, so form gaps acceptable for ordinary concrete can leak paste, leaving voids inside the joint and a sunken surface; it also exerts near-hydrostatic pressure on the forms. FHWA advises forms tighter than for ordinary concrete, an exit path for air and a raised chimney that provides extra head to offset subsidence after placement; some contractors water-test the forms for leaks. Visible horizontal surfaces are often overfilled and ground flush with the adjacent deck after hardening, but grinding too early tears the UHPC and too late wears out the equipment.
units.model: 液態側壓 p = ρ·g·h。UHPC 密度取 2,550 kg/m³，板厚 0.2 m 加溢流頭 0.15 m，h = 0.35 m，p = 2,550×9.81×0.35 ≈ 8.8 kPa。一道 12 m 長、152 mm 寬的接縫體積 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³，含 10% 損耗約 0.40 m³。數值為教學假設。~Fluid form pressure p = ρ·g·h. With UHPC density 2,550 kg/m³ and a 0.2 m deck plus 0.15 m overfill head, h = 0.35 m and p = 2,550×9.81×0.35 ≈ 8.8 kPa. A 12 m long, 152 mm wide joint holds 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³, about 0.40 m³ with 10% waste. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置前檢查模板密封與注水試驗結果、排氣路徑與溢流頭高度；澆置時由一端連續推進，觀察另一端與排氣孔出漿；初凝前保持封閉保濕，記錄養護溫度，並依 FHWA 建議在強度達約 70 MPa 前防止受凍、達 97 MPa（14 ksi）後才拆模與承受施工荷重。~Before casting check form sealing and any water-test result, air vents and overfill head height; place continuously from one end, watching for paste at the far end and vents; keep sealed and moist until initial set, log curing temperatures, and per FHWA guidance protect from freezing until about 70 MPa and strip forms or apply construction load only after 97 MPa (14 ksi).
units.failure: 模板底部縫隙漏漿，接縫底部形成蜂窩與空洞，頂面下陷後只能以一般砂漿補平；或在強度不足時就研磨與開放施工車輛，表面被撕裂、纖維外露，接縫頂面成為日後滲水與剝落的起點。~Paste leaking from gaps at the bottom of the forms leaves honeycombing and voids at the joint base, and the sunken top is patched with ordinary mortar; grinding or allowing site traffic before adequate strength tears the surface and exposes fibres, starting future leakage and spalling at the joint top.
units.misconception: UHPC 可以像一般混凝土一樣用普通模板，漏一點漿不影響品質。~UHPC can use ordinary formwork, and a little paste leakage does not matter.
units.practice: 首道接縫前做一次實尺寸試澆（mock-up），驗證模板密封、拌合、澆置順序、溢流與研磨時機；拆模與開放施工荷重以試體強度為停留點，而非以天數判斷。~Before the first joint, cast a full-size mock-up to prove form sealing, mixing, placement sequence, overfill and grinding timing; stripping and construction loading are hold points based on specimen strength, not on elapsed days.

units.anchor: 流度與抗壓試體~Flow and compression specimens
units.title: 材料驗收試驗~Material acceptance testing
units.mechanism: UHPC 的現場驗收比一般混凝土更依賴試驗：每一盤都要以流度試驗確認工作性，因為流度太低會包住空氣、太高可能代表加水或纖維沉降；抗壓試體則決定何時可拆模、何時可承載。FHWA 建議的驗收項目包括流度約 178 至 254 mm、4 天抗壓大於 14 ksi、28 天大於 21 ksi、氯離子滲透 28 天不超過 250 庫侖、凍融 300 次後相對動彈性模數至少 95%、28 天收縮不超過 800 微應變，抗壓試體至少每 19 m³ 或每 12 小時班次取一次。~Site acceptance of UHPC relies on testing even more than for ordinary concrete: every batch is flow-tested for workability, because low flow traps air and high flow may mean added water or fibre settlement, while compressive specimens decide when forms come off and when load may be applied. FHWA-recommended acceptance covers flow of about 178 to 254 mm, compressive strength above 14 ksi at 4 days and above 21 ksi at 28 days, chloride penetrability of at most 250 coulombs at 28 days, relative dynamic modulus of at least 95% after 300 freeze–thaw cycles and 28-day shrinkage of at most 800 microstrain, with compressive specimens taken at least once per 19 m³ or per 12-hour shift.
units.model: 直徑 76.2 mm 圓柱試體面積 A = π/4×76.2² ≈ 4,560 mm²，破壞荷重 680 kN，f = 680,000/4,560 ≈ 149 MPa，高於 21 ksi（約 145 MPa）；試驗機容量需大於 680 kN 並預留餘裕，試體端面需研磨平整。數值為教學假設。~A 76.2 mm diameter cylinder has A = π/4×76.2² ≈ 4,560 mm²; a failure load of 680 kN gives f = 680,000/4,560 ≈ 149 MPa, above 21 ksi (about 145 MPa); the testing machine must exceed 680 kN with margin and specimen ends must be ground flat. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每盤記錄拌合時間、溫度與流度，流度超出範圍即退料；抗壓試體依規定頻率取樣並與接縫同條件養護，另取一組標準養護；試驗報告須標明試體尺寸、端面處理與試驗機容量，結果與允收值比較後決定拆模與開放。~Record mixing time, temperature and flow for every batch, rejecting any outside the range; take compression specimens at the required frequency, cured alongside the joint, plus a standard-cured set; reports state specimen size, end preparation and machine capacity, and results are compared with acceptance values to decide stripping and opening.
units.failure: 以一般混凝土實驗室的試驗機與未研磨端面測試 UHPC，量到的強度偏低或試驗機容量不足；或只取 28 天試體，沒有早期強度資料，結果為趕工在未達要求強度時就拆模開放，接縫在早期就受損。~Testing UHPC on an ordinary concrete lab machine with unground ends gives low strengths or exceeds machine capacity; taking only 28-day specimens leaves no early-strength data, so forms are stripped and traffic admitted to meet the schedule before the required strength, damaging the joint early.
units.misconception: UHPC 一定很強，只要按配比拌合就不必做驗收試驗。~UHPC is always strong, so batching by the recipe makes acceptance testing unnecessary.
units.practice: 品質計畫列出每項試驗的標準、頻率與允收值，指定具 UHPC 試驗能力的實驗室；流度不合格的批次一律不得澆入接縫，且由監造見證取樣。~The quality plan lists standard, frequency and acceptance value for each test and names a laboratory capable of UHPC testing; batches failing flow may not be placed in the joint, and sampling is witnessed by the inspector.

units.anchor: 跨縫應變與噴水試驗~Cross-joint strain and spray test
units.title: 接縫性能驗證與監測~Joint performance verification and monitoring
units.mechanism: UHPC 接縫的設計規則來自實驗室中對接縫試體的靜載與反覆載重試驗，但每座橋仍需在現場確認接縫的實際表現：通車前做噴水或灑水檢查介面是否滲漏；通車後以跨縫應變計、裂縫寬度量測與定期目視比較接縫與兩側板的行為。紐約州 2013 年在雪城 I-81 以全深度預鑄橋面板加 6 吋 UHPC 接縫更換四座州際公路橋，不使用後拉預力，南北向各以 10 天封路完成，為此類監測提供了典型對象。~Design rules for UHPC joints come from static and cyclic laboratory tests on joint specimens, yet each bridge still needs field confirmation of joint behaviour: before opening, spray or flood the joints to check for interface leaks; after opening, compare joint and panel behaviour with cross-joint strain gauges, crack-width measurements and periodic visual inspection. In 2013 New York replaced four interstate bridges on I-81 in Syracuse with full-depth precast panels and 6 inch UHPC joints, without post-tensioning, completing each direction under a 10-day closure, a typical subject for such monitoring.
units.model: 介面附近預鑄板側應變計在設計車輛下讀得 100 με，E_c = 30 GPa，σ = 30,000×100×10⁻⁶ = 3.0 MPa，接近一般混凝土開裂應力；UHPC 側同一荷重讀 120 με、E = 48 GPa，σ ≈ 5.8 MPa，仍低於 8.5 MPa。數值除 UHPC 性質外為教學假設。~A gauge on the precast side near the interface reads 100 με under the design vehicle; with E_c = 30 GPa, σ = 30,000×100×10⁻⁶ = 3.0 MPa, near ordinary concrete's cracking stress; on the UHPC side the same load reads 120 με with E = 48 GPa, σ ≈ 5.8 MPa, still below 8.5 MPa. Values other than UHPC properties are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 通車前以噴水或圍堰灑水檢查每道接縫底面是否有滲漏痕跡；選擇代表性接縫安裝跨縫應變計與裂縫計，以已知重量車輛做靜載與慢速通過試驗，比較跨縫與板內應變比值；之後每年目視記錄裂縫位置與寬度。~Before opening spray or pond each joint and check the soffit for seepage; instrument representative joints with cross-joint strain and crack gauges, run static and crawl-speed tests with known vehicles and compare strain ratios across the joint and within the panel; thereafter record crack locations and widths visually each year.
units.failure: 只檢查 UHPC 本體是否有裂縫，忽略介面細縫；介面滲漏未在通車前發現，冬季除冰鹽水沿介面滲到下方，等到梁底出現鏽水才察覺，修補時必須封路處理。~Checking only the UHPC for cracks while ignoring fine interface cracks lets interface leaks go unnoticed before opening; winter brine then seeps to the girders below and the problem is found only when rust stains appear, requiring a closure to repair.
units.misconception: 接縫只要表面看不到裂縫，就代表不會滲水。~If no crack is visible on the joint surface, it cannot leak.
units.practice: 把「通車前滲水檢查」列為驗收停留點，滲漏處須在通車前以注射或表面封護處理；代表性接縫的監測資料連同試驗車重量與位置一起存檔，作為長期比較的基準。~Make the pre-opening leak check an acceptance hold point and treat any leak by injection or surface sealing before opening; archive monitoring data for representative joints with test-vehicle weights and positions as the long-term baseline.

units.anchor: 氯離子擴散深度~Chloride diffusion depth
units.title: 耐久性、氯離子與接縫防水~Durability, chloride and joint watertightness
units.mechanism: 橋面接縫是除冰鹽與雨水最容易進入結構的位置：一般現澆接縫因收縮與荷載開裂，氯離子沿裂縫與孔隙到達鋼筋，引起腐蝕與剝落。UHPC 的孔隙不連通，FHWA 數據顯示 28 天氯離子滲透僅約 360 庫侖、凍融 600 次後相對動彈性模數仍約 99%，本體幾乎不讓氯離子進入；因此長期耐久的瓶頸轉到介面與兩側預鑄板。耐久設計要同時處理介面開裂、鋪面層與防水層，以及接縫下方排水。~Deck joints are where de-icing salt and rain most easily enter a structure: ordinary field-cast joints crack from shrinkage and load, and chlorides travel through cracks and pores to the bars, causing corrosion and spalling. UHPC's pore structure is discontinuous; FHWA data show only about 360 coulombs of chloride penetrability at 28 days and a relative dynamic modulus of about 99% after 600 freeze–thaw cycles, so the material itself admits almost no chloride, and the long-term bottleneck shifts to the interface and the adjacent precast panels. Durability design must address interface cracking, the wearing surface and waterproofing, and drainage below the joint.
units.model: 擴散深度近似 x ≈ 2√(D·t)，t = 50 年 ≈ 1.58×10⁹ s。一般混凝土 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s：x ≈ 2√(1.58×10⁻³) ≈ 0.079 m = 79 mm，超過 50 mm 保護層；UHPC 取 D = 2×10⁻¹⁴ m²/s：x ≈ 11 mm。數值為教學假設，介面裂縫不適用擴散模型。~Diffusion depth x ≈ 2√(D·t) with t = 50 years ≈ 1.58×10⁹ s. Ordinary concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s gives x ≈ 2√(1.58×10⁻³) ≈ 0.079 m = 79 mm, beyond 50 mm cover; UHPC with D = 2×10⁻¹⁴ m²/s gives x ≈ 11 mm. Values are teaching assumptions; diffusion does not apply through interface cracks.
units.verify: 定期以目視、敲擊與裂縫量測檢查接縫與介面；在介面附近的預鑄板鑽取粉末測氯離子濃度剖面，與基準比較；鋪面層若覆蓋接縫，翻修時要檢查其下方介面，並確認排水坡度與排水孔暢通。~Inspect joints and interfaces periodically by eye, sounding and crack measurement; drill powder samples in the precast panel near the interface for chloride profiles compared with the baseline; where an overlay covers the joint, inspect the interface beneath it during resurfacing and confirm drainage falls and outlets are clear.
units.failure: 管理單位以為 UHPC 接縫永不需要維護而省略鋪面防水，介面細縫多年持續滲入鹽水，兩側預鑄板邊緣鋼筋腐蝕膨脹、混凝土剝落，最終必須局部打除重做接縫與板邊。~An owner that assumes UHPC joints never need maintenance and omits overlay waterproofing lets brine seep through interface cracks for years; bars at the panel edges corrode and expand, the concrete spalls and the joint and panel edges must eventually be broken out and recast.
units.misconception: UHPC 不透水，所以整條接縫及其周邊都不會發生腐蝕。~UHPC is impermeable, so neither the joint nor its surroundings can corrode.
units.practice: 耐久設計說明書要分別評估 UHPC、介面與預鑄板的劣化機制與檢查頻率；橋面防水與鋪面層的維護週期與接縫檢查結合，介面裂縫寬度超過門檻時立即封護。~The durability statement assesses deterioration mechanisms and inspection frequency separately for the UHPC, the interface and the precast panels; deck waterproofing and overlay maintenance are tied to joint inspection, and interface cracks wider than a threshold are sealed promptly.

units.anchor: 裂縫滲流與封護門檻~Crack seepage and sealing threshold
units.title: 維修、改建與工程交接~Repair, modification and engineering handover
units.mechanism: UHPC 接縫的維修與日後改建需要事先規劃：它比一般混凝土硬得多，局部打除、水刀或鋸切都較困難，橋面拓寬或更換板時要預先決定切割位置；鋪面研磨與更換也要避免傷及接縫。滲水量對裂縫寬度極為敏感，因此維修門檻應以裂縫寬度表示，小裂縫及早封護遠比等到鏽水出現再處理便宜。交接文件要讓後續管理者知道每道接縫的位置、材料、試驗與監測基準。~Repair and later modification of UHPC joints need planning: UHPC is much harder than ordinary concrete, so local breakout, hydrodemolition or saw-cutting is more difficult, and cut lines for future widening or panel replacement should be decided in advance; overlay milling and replacement must also avoid damaging the joints. Leakage is extremely sensitive to crack width, so repair thresholds should be expressed in crack width, and early sealing of small cracks is far cheaper than waiting for rust stains. Handover documents must tell future managers where every joint is and its materials, tests and monitoring baselines.
units.model: 平行板裂縫滲流 q = (w³/12μ)·(Δp/L)·ℓ。w = 0.2 mm、μ = 1×10⁻³ Pa·s、10 mm 積水 Δp ≈ 98 Pa、板厚 L = 0.2 m、裂縫長 12 m：q ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ m³/s，約 14 L/h；w 減半為 0.1 mm 時降為約 1.8 L/h（1/8）。數值為教學假設。~Parallel-plate crack flow q = (w³/12μ)·(Δp/L)·ℓ. With w = 0.2 mm, μ = 1×10⁻³ Pa·s, 10 mm of ponding giving Δp ≈ 98 Pa, deck thickness L = 0.2 m and 12 m of crack: q ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ m³/s, about 14 L/h; halving w to 0.1 mm cuts it to about 1.8 L/h (one eighth). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查記錄裂縫寬度與長度並與交接基準比較，超過封護門檻（例如 0.2 mm，教學假設）即排入維修；改建或拓寬前由設計者確認切割位置、鋼筋續接方式與新舊 UHPC 或混凝土的介面處理。~Periodic inspections record crack width and length against handover baselines, scheduling sealing once a threshold (for example 0.2 mm, a teaching assumption) is exceeded; before modification or widening, the designer confirms cut lines, bar splicing and the interface treatment between new and old UHPC or concrete.
units.failure: 沒有接縫竣工資料，日後鋪面銑刨時切入 UHPC 接縫頂面，纖維外露並形成凹槽；橋面拓寬時在接縫中央鋸切，切斷搭接鋼筋卻無法重新續接，只好擴大打除範圍與封路時間。~Without as-built joint records, later overlay milling cuts into the UHPC joint top, exposing fibres and leaving a trough; widening by saw-cutting through the middle of a joint severs the lap bars with no way to re-splice them, forcing larger breakouts and longer closures.
units.misconception: UHPC 接縫耐久性極高，交接後就不需要任何紀錄或維修規劃。~UHPC joints are so durable that no records or repair planning are needed after handover.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含每道接縫的位置圖、UHPC 產品與批號、流度與強度試驗、介面處理紀錄、滲水檢查結果、監測基準與裂縫封護門檻；任何切割、銑刨或拓寬工程須先經設計者核定方法與停留點。~Handover includes a location plan of every joint, UHPC product and batch numbers, flow and strength tests, interface-treatment records, leak-check results, monitoring baselines and crack-sealing thresholds; any cutting, milling or widening requires the designer's approval of method and hold points first.

example: 設計練習：兩塊全深度預鑄橋面板厚 200 mm，以 UHPC 橫向接縫連接，伸出 16 mm 鋼筋@150 mm（f_y = 420 MPa，低於 75 ksi），保護層 50 mm（≥ 3d_b = 48 mm）。依 FHWA 規則 ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm，採 120 mm 搭接、152 mm 接縫，兩側各留 16 mm 允差。若改用 100 ksi 級鋼筋且保護層 40 mm（2.5d_b），ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm，接縫應加寬到約 203 mm。一道 12 m 長接縫 UHPC 體積 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³，含 10% 損耗約 0.40 m³，鋼纖維約 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg。介面剪力以剪力摩擦估算：粗糙化 6 mm 約 895 kN/m，未粗糙化約 442 kN/m，差約 2 倍。驗收：流度 178 至 254 mm，抗壓達 97 MPa（14 ksi）才拆模與承受施工荷重，28 天大於 145 MPa（21 ksi）；76.2 mm 圓柱試體破壞荷重 680 kN 即約 149 MPa。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design exercise: two full-depth precast deck panels 200 mm thick are joined by a transverse UHPC joint with projecting 16 mm bars at 150 mm (f_y = 420 MPa, below 75 ksi) and 50 mm cover (at least 3d_b = 48 mm). By the FHWA rule ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm, so a 120 mm lap in a 152 mm joint leaves 16 mm tolerance each side. With 100 ksi bars and 40 mm cover (2.5d_b), ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm, so the joint should widen to about 203 mm. A 12 m joint holds 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³ of UHPC, about 0.40 m³ with 10% waste and about 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg of steel fibre. Shear friction gives interface capacity of about 895 kN/m when roughened to 6 mm and about 442 kN/m unroughened, roughly a factor of 2. Acceptance: flow of 178 to 254 mm, stripping and construction loading only at 97 MPa (14 ksi), and above 145 MPa (21 ksi) at 28 days; a 76.2 mm cylinder failing at 680 kN is about 149 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 美國聯邦公路總署的 Turner-Fairbank 研究中心在 2000 年代研究 UHPC 用於預鑄橋梁構件的現澆接縫，2009 年紐約州交通部完成首批應用：Lyons 的 SR 31 跨 Canandaigua Outlet 橋（預鑄 T 梁翼板接縫）與 Oneonta 的 SR 23 跨 Otego Creek 橋（預鑄橋面板接縫）。2013 年紐約州在雪城 I-81 以全深度預鑄橋面板與 6 吋 UHPC 接縫更換四座州際公路橋，每個方向以 10 天封路完成；FHWA 於 2014 年發布現澆 UHPC 接縫設計與施工技術說明，2017 至 2018 年的 Every Day Counts 第四輪（EDC-4）則全國推廣預鑄構件的 UHPC 接縫。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或產品配比。~FHWA's Turner-Fairbank Highway Research Center studied UHPC for field-cast connections between prefabricated bridge elements during the 2000s, and in 2009 the New York State DOT completed the first applications: SR 31 over the Canandaigua Outlet in Lyons (deck-bulb-tee flange connections) and SR 23 over Otego Creek in Oneonta (precast deck-panel connections). In 2013 New York replaced four interstate bridges on I-81 in Syracuse with full-depth precast panels and 6 inch UHPC joints, completing each direction under a 10-day closure; FHWA published its TechNote on designing and building field-cast UHPC connections in 2014, and the fourth round of Every Day Counts (EDC-4) in 2017 to 2018 promoted UHPC connections for prefabricated elements nationwide. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or product mix designs.
facts: FHWA 定義 UHPC 抗壓強度大於 21.7 ksi（150 MPa）、持續開裂後拉力強度大於 0.72 ksi（5 MPa）、水膠比低於 0.25~FHWA defines UHPC as having compressive strength above 21.7 ksi (150 MPa), sustained post-cracking tensile strength above 0.72 ksi (5 MPa) and a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25
現澆 UHPC 常用 2% 體積比鋼纖維，直徑 0.2 mm、長 13 mm、抗拉強度至少 2,000 MPa~Field-cast UHPC commonly uses 2% steel fibre by volume, 0.2 mm in diameter and 13 mm long, with tensile strength of at least 2,000 MPa

FHWA 數據：現澆 UHPC 28 天抗壓平均約 165 MPa，直接拉伸開裂約 8.5 MPa，彈性模數約 48 GPa~FHWA data: field-cast UHPC averages about 165 MPa at 28 days, with about 8.5 MPa direct tensile cracking strength and about 48 GPa modulus
FHWA 建議直線搭接 ℓ_s ≥ 0.75ℓ_d，ℓ_d 在 8 號以下、f_y ≤ 75 ksi、保護層 ≥ 3d_b 時取 8d_b~FHWA recommends straight laps ℓ_s ≥ 0.75ℓ_d, with ℓ_d = 8d_b for No. 8 and smaller bars, f_y ≤ 75 ksi and cover ≥ 3d_b
FHWA 建議預鑄介面粗糙化約 6.4 mm 幅度，UHPC 達 14 ksi（97 MPa）後才拆模~FHWA recommends roughening precast interfaces to about 6.4 mm amplitude and stripping forms only after UHPC reaches 14 ksi (97 MPa)
2009 年紐約州 SR 31（Lyons）與 SR 23（Oneonta）兩座橋為首批現澆 UHPC 接縫應用~In 2009 SR 31 in Lyons and SR 23 in Oneonta, New York, were the first 2 bridges with field-cast UHPC connections
2013 年雪城 I-81 四座橋以 6 吋 UHPC 接縫連接全深度預鑄橋面板，每方向 10 天封路~In 2013 four I-81 bridges in Syracuse used 6 inch UHPC joints between full-depth precast panels, with a 10-day closure per direction
FHWA 建議流度約 178 至 254 mm、28 天抗壓大於 21 ksi、28 天收縮不超過 800 微應變~FHWA recommends flow of about 178 to 254 mm, 28-day strength above 21 ksi and 28-day shrinkage of at most 800 microstrain
FHWA 數據：UHPC 28 天氯離子滲透約 360 庫侖，凍融 600 次後相對動彈性模數約 99%~FHWA data: UHPC shows about 360 coulombs chloride penetrability at 28 days and about 99% relative dynamic modulus after 600 freeze–thaw cycles
